reviewCharts.warning: Nebraska review rows are county-level President-versus-U.S. Senate two-year special election comparisons from the official 2024 General Canvass Book. They are useful for county review, but they are not precinct-level vote-share scatter plots.

turnout.notes: Nebraska turnout rows currently use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback ballots-cast and registered-voter rows. The official 2024 General Canvass Book also includes county voting-statistics tables with registered voters and total voting by method, and the post-general eligible-voter report is retained as a state-native registration denominator cross-check. Add a Nebraska canvass voting-statistics normalizer before replacing the EAC parser.

stateNativeCanvassVotingStatistics.caveat: The current EAC fallback ballots-cast total is 965,145; the official canvass Total Voting statewide value is 965,236. Reconcile this source difference before replacing fallback turnout rows.

historicalBaselines.warning: Nebraska historical baseline rows are official county-level presidential results from 2012, 2016, and 2020 General Canvass Book PDFs. Use them as contextual baseline rows, not as 2024 certified data.
